title: Chinese profits rose 25.7%. The CSI 300 fell 9% and the Star 50 fell 29%
summary:
Profits at onshore-listed Chinese companies rose 25.7% in the three months to June, the fastest in nearly five years and heavily concentrated in AI-linked firms.
The CSI 300 has fallen about 9% this quarter and the tech-heavy Star 50 has dropped 29%, as investors began treating AI spending as a cost rather than a promise.

title: Reform promises to increase tax-free personal allowance to £15,000
summary:
Reform UK is promising to increase the tax-free personal allowance to £15,000, if it wins the next general election.
It is seen by Reform insiders as the flagship policy announcement of its conference and perhaps their biggest tax policy between now and the general election.
Electoral law sets out that to be a donor to a UK political party you must be a UK registered voter, or a company registered in the UK.
Farage said on Friday that his party had "done nothing wrong" and had taken "no illegal money.
Jenrick told the Today programme that the party had taken legal advice and it did not believe it had done anything wrong.
